tool.name: AriB Narrative Intelligence
tool.question: What is crypto news covering, how is its tone moving, and how strong is the evidence?

public_api.auth: API key in header (optional for the free tier)

endpoints.summary: Current news tone, evidence counts and leading narratives.
Point-in-time history: series = index, news-tone, coin, price, calls. Query: start, end (ISO-8601), coin, format=json|csv.
Lead/lag statistics of an index against price. Query: series, days.
Rule backtest on stored history (Track Record rules by default).

datasets.description: Original AriB Sentiment Index (0-100, relative to its own baseline), one point per cycle.
